layouts.name: CBitmapSource_GetNineGridMargins
layouts.notes: CBitmapSource::Create stores the caller-supplied MARGINS at +0x20, while CAtlasedImage::AppendAtlasNineGrid and CDrawNineGridInstruction::Initialize independently read a second MARGINS at +0x30. Verified on uDWM 17763.719, 19041.3758, 22000.194, and 22621.6630. ButtonGlowHandler writes the theme-atlas destination margins here for the native nine-grid path; its separate size calculation uses OpenGlass-owned storage.

layouts.name: CBitmapSource_GetProxy
layouts.notes: CDrawImageInstruction::Create copies CBitmapSource+16 into its source proxy field.

layouts.name: CBitmapSource_SourceSize
layouts.notes: Create stores the cropped source RECT's width and height here. UpdateButtonVisuals consumes the height when testing whether a glyph fits; this is not the visual's destination size.

layouts.name: CBitmapSource_ContentMargins
layouts.notes: CreateNCButtons copies GetThemeMargins(TMT_CONTENTMARGINS) into every background state. UpdateButtonVisuals adds the first normal close-button state's top and bottom margins to each candidate glyph height. Distinct from sizing and nine-grid destination margins.
